chunks: And through his chain of narration, from Ali (peace be upon him), who said:
Indeed, the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) wore his ring on his right hand.

key_terms.صَلَى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ: Peace be upon him and his family
key_terms.يَتَخَتَّمُ: He wore a ring (specifically on the finger)

ai.seo_question: Did the Prophet Muhammad wear his ring on his right or left hand?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida*, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) specifies that the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) wore his signet ring on his right hand, a detail that distinguishes the Sunnah from later cultural variations. This practice is significant in Shia jurisprudence as it underscores the Prophet's adherence to the right side (al-yamin) in personal adornment, reinforcing the spiritual and physical purity associated with the right hand in Islamic tradition.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 31-269 According to the same documentation, it is narrated that Ali (a.s.) said, “
The Prophet (S) wore his ring on his right hand.”
